changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0009. Create tenant licenses and feature flags. Index review: PK_TenantLicenses on Id; UX_TenantLicenses_TenantId allows one Active license per tenant, which is the feature-gate lookup; IX_TenantLicenses_TenantId_ExpiresAt supports "which license is current" including expired rows the unique index excludes; UX_FeatureFlags_LicenseId_FeatureCode prevents a duplicate flag and is the enablement lookup. Status is not indexed alone because license checks always start from TenantId. Performance note: both unique indexes are narrow and filtered or prefixed by the parent key.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE app.TenantLicenses ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, [Plan] NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, Status NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, StartsAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, ExpiresAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_TenantLicenses PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_TenantLicenses_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_TenantLicenses_Plan CHECK ([Plan] IN (N'Free', N'Basic', N'Pro', N'Enterprise')), CONSTRAINT CK_TenantLicenses_Status CHECK (Status IN (N'Active', N'Expired', N'Suspended', N'Cancelled')) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_TenantLicenses_TenantId ON app.TenantLicenses (TenantId) WHERE Status = N'Active' AND DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_TenantLicenses_TenantId_ExpiresAt ON app.TenantLicenses (TenantId, ExpiresAt) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL;
CREATE TABLE app.FeatureFlags ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, LicenseId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, FeatureCode NVARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, [Enabled] BIT NOT NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_FeatureFlags PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_FeatureFlags_TenantLicenses FOREIGN KEY (LicenseId) REFERENCES app.TenantLicenses (Id) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_FeatureFlags_LicenseId_FeatureCode ON app.FeatureFlags (LicenseId, FeatureCode);

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE app.FeatureFlags; DROP TABLE app.TenantLicenses;

changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0010. Create refresh-token and password-reset storage. Only hashes are stored. Index review: PK on Id; UX_RefreshTokens_TokenHash and UX_PasswordResetTokens_TokenHash are the presented-token lookup; IX_RefreshTokens_UserId covers active-token revocation for one user; IX_RefreshTokens_ReplacedByTokenId supports the replacement foreign key; IX_PasswordResetTokens_UserId supports the user foreign key. ExpiresAt is the second column of the user index because revocation lists active rows for a user rather than scanning by expiry alone. Performance note: hash indexes are unique and equal to the lookup predicate.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE app.RefreshTokens ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, UserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TokenHash NVARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, ExpiresAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, RevokedAt DATETIME2 NULL, ReplacedByTokenId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, CreatedByIp NVARCHAR(64) NULL, RevokedByIp NVARCHAR(64) NULL, UserAgent NVARCHAR(512) NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_RefreshTokens PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_RefreshTokens_Users FOREIGN KEY (UserId) REFERENCES app.Users (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_RefreshTokens_RefreshTokens FOREIGN KEY (ReplacedByTokenId) REFERENCES app.RefreshTokens (Id) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_RefreshTokens_TokenHash ON app.RefreshTokens (TokenHash); CREATE INDEX IX_RefreshTokens_UserId ON app.RefreshTokens (UserId, ExpiresAt) WHERE RevokedAt IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_RefreshTokens_ReplacedByTokenId ON app.RefreshTokens (ReplacedByTokenId) WHERE ReplacedByTokenId IS NOT NULL;
CREATE TABLE app.PasswordResetTokens ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, UserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TokenHash NVARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, ExpiresAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UsedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_PasswordResetTokens PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_PasswordResetTokens_Users FOREIGN KEY (UserId) REFERENCES app.Users (Id) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_PasswordResetTokens_TokenHash ON app.PasswordResetTokens (TokenHash); CREATE INDEX IX_PasswordResetTokens_UserId ON app.PasswordResetTokens (UserId);

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE app.PasswordResetTokens; DROP TABLE app.RefreshTokens;

changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0011. Create AuditLogs for identity and licensing changes. Index review: PK_AuditLogs on Id; IX_AuditLogs_TenantId_CreatedAt serves workspace history in time order; IX_AuditLogs_UserId_CreatedAt serves one user's security history. Entity plus EntityId is not indexed because Part 2 does not query audit rows by entity. Performance note: both secondary indexes match the only planned filters and lead with the equality column.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE app.AuditLogs ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, Action NVARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, Entity NVARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, EntityId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, OldValues NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, NewValues NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, IPAddress NVARCHAR(64) NULL, UserAgent NVARCHAR(512) NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_AuditLogs PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_AuditLogs_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_AuditLogs_Users FOREIGN KEY (UserId) REFERENCES app.Users (Id) ); CREATE INDEX IX_AuditLogs_TenantId_CreatedAt ON app.AuditLogs (TenantId, CreatedAt) WHERE TenantId IS NOT NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_AuditLogs_UserId_CreatedAt ON app.AuditLogs (UserId, CreatedAt) WHERE UserId IS NOT NULL;
